info.name: Apache Log4j RCE (Log4Shell)
author: pdteam
info.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

info.name: Git Config Exposure
author: pdteam
info.description: .git/config was exposed leading to repository disclosure.
info.remediation: Restrict web server access to dotfiles like .git

info.name: Deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 Supported
author: pdteam
info.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 in web server configuration.
